list: the official 55 trophies, as PlayStation publishes them
note: Names and descriptions are the official list. Guides are written for this entry in our own words; each cites the guide or list it draws on. Two trophies are flagged unconfirmed where no verified method exists yet.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are done — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through the roadmap below; the last trophy you earn will almost always be A Long Road (100% completion) or one of the clean-up trophies in Stage 3.
steps: Finish the story (Stage 1)
Complete the 100% checklist (Stage 2)
Clean up Strangers & Freaks and the rest (Stage 3)

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It unlocks as part of the story and cannot be missed.
steps: Play through Gone Fishing (Chapter 1)

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 1 — it pops when you start the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?
steps: Finish every mission of Chapter 1

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 2 — it pops when the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, begins.
steps: Finish every mission of Chapter 2

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 3 — it pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
steps: Finish every mission of Chapter 3

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 4 — it pops when you finish the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero.
steps: Finish every mission of Chapter 4, ending with Starting From Zero

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the final mission of the game. Like the other story trophies it unlocks automatically and cannot be missed. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter, since there is no mission replay — the game has 15 manual save slots.
steps: Play the story through to its final mission

sources.name: GTASpotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2.
steps: Finish the mission Breakfast Run (Chapter 2)

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.
steps: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist (Chapter 3)

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Child's Play in Chapter 4.
steps: Finish the mission Child's Play (Chapter 4)

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Headliners in Chapter 4.
steps: Finish the mission Headliners (Chapter 4)

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.
steps: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown (Chapter 4)

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.
steps: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory (Chapter 5)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist, which appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story. It is far more forgiving than it sounds — roughly 60% true completion: most side quests are not required, and of the things that are, you usually need only 70–80% of them. The only tasks that demand everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests, and you need any 70 of the 80 challenges. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable.
steps: Finish the story first — progress counts from the start
Scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles with the WAiNK app
Study 100 of 255 animals through the binoculars
Complete any 100 optional missions (there are 200–300+)
Finish all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests
Complete any 70 of 80 challenges

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. There are four kinds — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps — and you can mix them freely, so pick the easiest. Flying under bridges in a plane is the quickest way to rack them up. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going after this pops. Track progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.
steps: Fly under bridges — the fastest way to rack up stunts
Mix in stunt jumps and base jumps as you find them
Check Progress > Activities > Stunts for your total

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / drone race, and performing a stunt. The game tracks them under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. You will do most of them naturally while chasing the other trophies; the map's Activities filter (blue dumbbell icon) marks the rest.
steps: Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see which types are done
Try any type you have not done yet

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. The golds are not very hard, and each range's challenges are short — work through them range by range. Your Focus level grows as you play shooting ranges, which also helps with Gunslinger.
steps: Visit each of the 12 shooting ranges
Gold every challenge at each range — 42 in total

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — 42 races in total, three per location. You only need one win per location for the trophy; the 100% checklist wants all of them.
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race marker and win it
Repeat at each of the other 13 locations

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so you have twice as many to choose from — use the map's race markers to find ones you have not won yet.
steps: Win races at 20 different locations
Use the map's race markers to find ones you have not won

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing spot west of Key Lento (purple map icon). Go there and beat him at fishing.
steps: Finish the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal)
Wait for Cal's text, then go to the marked spot west of Key Lento
Win the fishing challenge

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. There are four video games — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home (use the controllers); the fourth is on arcade machines around the world. Finishing all the levels of any one of them once is enough — you do not need to beat every challenge inside it.
steps: Play any of the four video games
Finish all its levels once

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Her questline is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3, when Andy calls and texts her home address in Belville. Five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. It stays available after the story.
steps: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 and wait for Andy's call
Complete her five quests, ending with Puff Puff Pass

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. His questline starts in Chapter 1, a while after the mission Island Dreams — he calls, then appears as the green 'KR' icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks: find the chests with the metal detector and bring them back. He goes quiet during part of Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2–3, so nothing is missable. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.
steps: Finish Island Dreams, then answer Kenton's call
Dive all 7 shipwrecks and return the treasure
Return to his shop when he calls you back

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. His questline is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. Still available after the story.
steps: Finish Coffee Break, then head to the Thrillbilly Mudclub
Complete Billy's five quests, ending with Hometown Heroes

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only certain questlines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk's Skunk Ape quests (Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle's farm quests, Yago's racing quests and Pilot Pete's delivery quests. All of them are still available after the story. The trophy tracker in the trophy list shows how many you have done.
steps: Find stranger questlines in the open world
Finish 8 counting strands — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed

sources.name: GTASpotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. His 'Randy's Wish List' questline starts after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso with the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (green 'RK' icon, west Vice City): Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee and Baller ST-D, plus the Zorrusso itself. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is on the list, then drive it back — a car delivered in good condition pays more.
steps: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS to unlock the Key Cloner
Deliver the 16 cars on Randy's list to his garage

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. His questline is Jason-only and starts after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers for Synthetic Labs appear in Vice City. Destroy the labs (quest: Take Out Kitty Litter), and Tyrone then gives you Spin On This — shut the labs down. Still available after the story.
steps: Play as Jason after Here, Kitty Kitty
Destroy the Synthetic Labs (Take Out Kitty Litter)
Complete Tyrone's second quest, Spin On This

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots at 10 locations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts twice, and you cannot finish the last one until you can play as both characters (after Chapter 2's Coffee Break). Track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. MISSABLE — READ FIRST: the very first meditation can only be done in Chapter 1, at Jason's house. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony — follow her, choose 'Accept', and she teaches you. It raises your meditation counter but is not marked as a spot, and it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy. Do it anyway — it costs a minute, and it is the only thing in the game that might lock you out of the platinum.
steps: CHAPTER 1 ONLY: after Down to Earth, meditate with Lucia on Jason's balcony
Meditate at all 18 spots — with both characters where you can
Check Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations

sources.name: GTASpotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His questline is Jason-only: after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, Bret Vogel texts you and marks the first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. He gives you the hunting rifle 'Killtelligence SM-69' (retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker) and marks hunting spots on the map; bring the animals he asks for back to him. The 100% checklist wants all 15 of his Target Decks, so this comes naturally. NOTE: as of 20 November 2026 it is still unconfirmed exactly which animal unlocks this trophy — finish his quests and it will come.
steps: Play as Jason after Coffee Break; answer Bret's text
Complete Veteran Hunted, then his hunting requests
Track Target Decks under Map > Activities

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 sets in the game; the 100% checklist wants 15 of them, so keep collecting after this pops.
steps: Find cards around Leonida
Complete any 3 full sets

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Scan the world with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1): 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags all count — any 100 will do.
steps: Scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures with WAiNK
Any 100 scans unlock it

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 in total and the 100% checklist wants any 70, so this pops on the way — pick the easiest ones and leave the hardest 10 alone. Track them under Progress > Challenges.
steps: Work through the easiest challenges first
50 done unlocks it; 70 are needed for 100%

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. You need both characters together, so this opens up after Chapter 2's Coffee Break — call your partner (hold Right + Triangle). Build 4 stars by causing chaos, then escape: a fast sports bike through traffic works, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a good escape route because the helicopter cannot follow you there. The trophy pops once you drive out of the red 'heat' zone. It also comes automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, which gives you 4 stars during bank vault robberies.
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner to your side
Reach a 4-star wanted level
Escape the red heat zone — the Ambrosia train tunnel is the easy way out

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Only possible after Coffee Break. Keep the red/blue flashing wanted level the whole time (not the red heat level), loot three shops in a row, and the trophy pops about half a minute after leaving the third shop — if it does not, hit a fourth. A good spot is the three jewelry stores in north Vice City, unlocked after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: rob a couple of items in each, and ideally break the back-room safe with sticky bombs.
steps: Call your partner, then rob a first shop
Keep your wanted level and rob two more shops in a row
Wait about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. There are 557 vehicles at launch; just stand on a busy road, open the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan passing vehicles (hold R1). Scanning is enough — you do not need to drive them. The 100% checklist wants 200 scanned, so this pops on the way. Check your totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
steps: Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app
100 unique vehicles discovered unlocks it

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming; it slows time and highlights weak spots, draining the purple focus bar. Buff your focus first (eat, drink, wash up at home, or take Adrenaline), then line up five enemies — gang members at gang operations work well — and drop them fast with an accurate full-auto weapon like the Duke 556. It does not seem to count against soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels and grows as you play shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and land headshots, so this gets easier late in the game.
steps: Raise your Focus level (shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing)
Buff focus, then activate Combat Focus (L3 + R3) on a group of gang enemies
Down 5 enemies before the focus runs out

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal — the ones connected to a boarding bridge, not the planes parked on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge and enter the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip and take off. Fly at least 1 km away from the airport and the trophy pops.
steps: Go to VCIA terminal E3/E4
Board the docked passenger plane and take off
Fly 1 km from the airport

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The Rhinos stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate (or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb in, and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County
Steal a Rhino tank from the south of the base
Fire on enemies until it unlocks

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and marks jewelry store robberies on the map. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun (not the kick, which trips the alarm), find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy pops shortly after you leave. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to get the Snap Gun
Enter a jewelry store's back door with the Snap Gun
Loot the safe, destroy the footage, disable the alarm, leave undetected

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Unlock them with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe): tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner — you cannot carry all the cash alone (hold Right to hand off a bag). After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark more security vans (finish his earlier Payday Loans jobs first). There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist wants all of them. Each robbery instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast bike and switch cars to break the heat. Up to $205,000 per bank.
steps: Finish That's Where The Money Is… to unlock bank vaults
Tail security vans to banks and rob the vaults
Rob any 5 vaults and escape — all 8 are needed for 100%

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…, since robbing a bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck — tail the truck to the bank, take the vault cash and escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray). You can also do it earlier: block an armored truck near a bank, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
steps: Finish That's Where The Money Is… (it pops automatically)
Or: bomb open an armored truck's back door and escape the heat

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the map is visible.
steps: Get a plane
Fly over every fogged area until the map is fully revealed

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total; one per gang is enough for the trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 39. They show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically from the story. Track each gang's count under Progress > Gangs.
steps: Find illegal operations (yellow icons) near you
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it standing next to the bar.
steps: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach
Buy an Apple Martini and drink it by the bar

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City — you need the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs to break into it — then drive straight through the showroom window. Only this blue Banshee counts; it is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. The trophy pops a moment after you drive away.
steps: Get the Key Cloner (Chapter 3: Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs)
Steal the blue Banshee from the south Vice City showroom
Drive it through the showroom window

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — it is one of the gang operations. Bring sticky bombs (Ammu-Nation) for the safe. The three items: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun 'Gutterball Moreland 850' on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway. You first go there in the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. The trophy pops after you escape the police — and if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns after a while, so it is not missable.
steps: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (Chapter 2: Hit Kingpin Bowling)
Take the watch, the Gutterball shotgun and the safe
Escape the police

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. You can only work on this after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Buy a fitness club membership and always train together — call your partner (hold Right + Triangle) and while one of you works out, the other trains too, so you make double progress. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). You can also work out at home after the story.
steps: After Coffee Break, join a fitness club
Train with both characters together until both hit max strength

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on criminal-profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) and you will see a small demon face whenever something counts. Robberies, clean escapes, stealthy objectives and fights all count, and it builds up passively — you will very likely get it while working on the other trophies. The profiles run Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable; the last one is permanent, so do not farm it by running over crowds of civilians and cops — that pushes you toward Irredeemable, where cops shoot on sight.
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications
Play normally — robberies and encounters count toward 500
Check progress by clicking the trophy in the trophy list

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED as of 20 November 2026. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — possibly robbing it again later in a specific way. The store is in Little Cuba, Vice City. No verified method exists yet: do not waste time on guesses; check back for an update once the community confirms it.
steps: No confirmed method yet — see the note above
The lead points to the Payday Loans store in Little Cuba

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, alone. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back until it appears. Follow the path from the car into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it: it drops the woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside to unlock the trophy.
steps: Go to the road north-west of Starlet Motel, Kelly County, after 2AM, alone
Wait for the blinking car to appear
Follow the path to the UFO, help the woman, walk her to her car

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Do it somewhere crowded, like Vice City or Ocean Beach.
steps: Get on a bike in a crowded area
Kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans, and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in one robbery, so this comes naturally with the robbery trophies.
steps: Finish Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer
Rob banks and Payday Loans for marked bills
Deliver $250,000 total to a fence

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. Shops include 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.
steps: Spend $100,000 total in shops
Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — the 8 purchasable garages (the 4 story garages do not count), $160,000 in total. They become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone. Buy them through the app; robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4, are the quick way to fund them.
steps: Finish Daily Driver to unlock the Vice City Real Estate app
Buy all 8 garages through the app ($160,000 total)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose 'Respray' and 'Register' in his garage. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. You need enough garages first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
steps: Finish Moses to unlock the Scooter Bros app
Buy garages for parking spots (see Little Boxes)
Drive 10 stolen vehicles to Moses and register them
